data.one_liner: Dart package for DateTime manipulation, formatting, and parsing operations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive set of functions and extension methods for DateTime objects in Dart. It supports adding durations, calculating differences, parsing, formatting, and checking date states.
use_when: You need to perform complex date and time calculations in Dart.
You want to format and parse dates using custom patterns.
You need convenient extension methods on DateTime instances.
avoid_when: You only need basic native DateTime functionality without extra helpers.
strengths: Extensive collection of date and time helper functions and extensions.
Inspired by the popular date-fns library.
weaknesses: Relies on the intl package which may add code size.
Limited to what is provided out-of-the-box for specialized timezones.
